decisions.reason: The lighting effect is already captured by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event, including its DJ-style visual purpose; no additional or corrected MODIFY is required.
The general request for logos and text does not change the existing client-confirmed base-logo style, leaf exclusion, font, or letter case.
The source mentions DJ-style knobs and general branding but does not change the cursive K marking, placement, or color on the dispense buttons.
The request to retain text and logos is consistent with the existing placards and does not alter their text, faces, or same-text rule.
The source requests color generally but establishes no replacement or modification to the existing beige-and-green color values.
Measurement markings around the bowls are decorative details and do not change bowl capacity, bowl form, or compactness constraints.
The magnetic-stirrer discussion concerns another possible version and does not replace or modify the current prototype's whisk-head configuration.
The aesthetic additions do not change the required dispensing flow, froth preservation, sequence, or sputtering constraints.
The source's visual-design decision does not modify any cleaning, sanitation, removability, or hidden-liquid-trap requirement.
The statement that functionality remains important reaffirms its priority but does not change the existing mixing-quality acceptance behavior.
The source does not change the spout's location, orientation, fabrication style, reference geometry, or pour direction.
The aesthetic request does not change the BOM deliverable or its approval status.
